_comment: GK-GAP-010: a public method's SigHashPreimage parameter must reach checkPreimage() on every path (spec/type-system.md 4.2). Refused cases carry the shared diagnostic; accepted cases must compile in every tier. A `return` ends its path: a private helper's check counts only if it precedes every return (helper-*-return cases). A SigHashPreimage parameter is tracked wherever it sits in the parameter list (wide-params-* cases: 64 parameters precede it). A contract method named checkPreimage is not the built-in (method-named-checkpreimage).
